title: Cozy Fireplace: Why Wood Crackles and Pops in the Fire!

lines.text: Warm little fire glowing bright, chasing away the chilly night!
lines.caps: Warm little fire glowing *BRIGHT, | chasing away the chilly *NIGHT!

lines.text: Snap, crackle, pop! What makes wooden logs pop and spark inside the fireplace?
lines.caps: Snap, crackle, *POP! | What makes wooden logs pop and *SPARK | inside the *FIREPLACE?

lines.text: Even dry firewood has tiny droplets of water and tree sap trapped deep inside!
lines.caps: Even dry firewood has *TINY | droplets of water and tree sap *TRAPPED | deep *INSIDE!

lines.text: Wood is made of microscopic cellulose straws that once carried water up the tree!
lines.caps: Wood is made of microscopic *CELLULOSE | straws that once carried water *UP | the *TREE!

lines.text: As fierce fire heats the log, that trapped water boils and turns into expanding steam!
lines.caps: As fierce fire *HEATS | the log, that trapped water boils and *TURNS | into expanding *STEAM!

lines.text: The steam expands over a thousand times, building immense pressure inside the wood tube!
lines.caps: The steam expands over a thousand *TIMES, | building immense pressure inside the *WOOD | *TUBE!

lines.text: Bam! The wood pocket bursts open with a loud pop, releasing a dancing spark!
lines.caps: *BAM! The wood pocket *BURSTS | open with a loud pop, releasing a *DANCING | *SPARK!

lines.text: Now you know the cozy physics behind your crackling winter fire!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the cozy *PHYSICS | behind your crackling winter *FIRE!
